blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark-theme dashboard with deliberate single-hue palette (#4477AA throughout) and clean uppercase panel labels, but the force-network node labels render at 9px and crowd the panel, and the color scatter's axis text is equally small — two concrete readability issues that keep it from 8.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt for both node and color-dot sizes, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max throughout, semantic monthly binning, no dual-axis or silent-gap issues; loses points only for lacking edge-case documentation and no explicit line.defined() guard (though no line chart is present).
flags: Update Storm (partial): synchronous O(n) bitFilter.set + bitFilter.filtered() called on every brush mousemove without debouncing — heavy computation escapes the RAF coalescing guard even though DOM updates are correctly deferred
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly defers all DOM mutations, no transitions eliminate race conditions, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and no feedback loops exist, but the bitmask recomputation over 34k records runs synchronously in every brush event before markDirty() is called.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views with a well-managed dirty-flag render loop stay under the working memory threshold, and the pre-computed (non-reheating) 60-node force layout reads cleanly, but the color scatter demands HCL domain knowledge to interpret and its dense rainbow confetti gives no obvious pattern at a glance.
